title: ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2610.37732v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many uses of language models end in a typed decision: a choice among a closed set of options, whose probabilities code can act on. Reading those probabilities from one forward pass is fast but often wrong on decisions that take several steps, such as arithmetic, counting, and date comparison. Letting the model think first fixes most of these errors, but costs seconds per decision instead of milliseconds. To pay for thinking only where it helps, ThinkJev builds a fast and a slow system from one open hybrid-thinking model that can answer directly or after a thought. System 1 reads the model's probabilities for the option letters when it answers directly; System 2 reads the same letters after the model has thought on the same cached prompt, so escalating repeats no work and both systems give probabilities over the same options. translated_title: ThinkJev：一种思考，任意预算，实现校准的类型化决策
translated_abstract: 语言模型的许多应用最终都归结为类型化决策：即在一组封闭的选项中做出选择，其概率可供代码直接使用。从单次前向传播中读取这些概率速度很快，但在需要多个步骤的决策上往往出错，例如算术、计数和日期比较。让模型先思考可以修复大部分此类错误，但代价是每次决策从毫秒级变成秒级。为了只在有帮助的地方支付思考的成本，ThinkJev 基于一个开放混合思考模型构建了快、慢两套系统，该模型既能直接回答，也能在思考后回答。系统 1 在模型直接回答时读取模型对选项字母的概率；系统 2 在模型对同一个缓存提示完成思考后读取相同的字母，因此升级推理不会重复工作，且两套系统对相同的选项给出概率。由于这些字母可以在任意数量的思考 token 之后被读取，一次采样的思考也能给出答案，从而在任意计算预算下使用。
tldr: ThinkJev 基于同一混合思考模型构建快慢双系统，利用缓存的提示和可随时读取的选项字母概率，让一次采样的思考就能在任意计算预算下提供校准的类型化决策，实现“只在需要处思考”。
en_tdlr: ThinkJev builds fast and slow systems from one hybrid-thinking model, where a single cached sampled thought yields calibrated option probabilities at any thought budget, so the model thinks only where it helps.
